name: Formalism
overview: The Scriptures reveal that God is not pleased with mere external rituals or sacrifices performed out of obligation, as He declares that He does not require offerings or burnt sacrifices to be continually before Him. Psalms 50 emphasizes God's sovereignty over all creation, stating that every beast and bird belongs to Him and that He is not dependent on the flesh or blood of animals for sustenance. This teaches that true worship must go beyond formalism and recognize God's lordship and the heart behind the act, rather than relying on ritualistic observance alone.
